name: Should I repair or replace my entire window casing?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my entire window casing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace depends on the extent of the damage. If only small sections of the casing show minor wear, repair is usually sufficient and cost-effective. However, if there's widespread rot, severe warping, or significant structural damage, especially to the underlying window frame, a full replacement is often the better long-term solution. A professional assessment can help determine the most appropriate and durable course of action for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor damage, but consider full replacement for widespread rot or severe structural issues. A professional can advise on the best solution.
